reason: The debug build crashes at launch on a fresh simulator (EXC_BREAKPOINT in DailyQuestApp.init() at DailyQuestApp.swift:13, a force unwrap of a 'Weekly review' lookup in DebugSeed.extraTitles, which holds only 'Daily review'), so Today never appears.

claims.criterion: On a fresh simulator, Today lists `Weekly review`, not completed, beside the seeded `Meditate`.
claims.observed: On a fresh simulator, `dq launch` reported 'the notification alert never came up' and `dq doctor` showed app_running:false and tree_readable:false. The app crashed twice, once at launch and once on `dq relaunch`. Both crash reports show EXC_BREAKPOINT (SIGTRAP), Swift _assertionFailure in DailyQuestApp.init() at DailyQuestApp.swift:13. Today never appeared and the screen shows the home screen.
The app crashes in DailyQuestApp.init() before any UI appears, so Today has no progress line. `dq tree` returned 'error: app not in foreground (state 1)'.
